name: agristack_generate_otp
description: Sends OTP for AgriStack authentication. Does NOT verify OTP. Fails if Aadhaar invalid.

aadhaar_number.description: 12-digit Aadhaar number of the farmer. Used as the unique identifier.

name: agristack_verify_otp
description: Verifies OTP and returns session_token. Does NOT register farmer. Fails if OTP expired or incorrect.

name: agristack_register_farmer
description: Registers a new farmer in the AgriStack registry. Each Aadhaar can have ONLY one profile (duplicates rejected). Transitions profile_status to 'registered'. Requires session_token. Does NOT verify land or complete profile. Fails if Aadhaar already registered.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: agristack_get_farmer_profile
description: Retrieves the farmer's registry profile including personal details, linked land parcels, and profile_status. Requires session_token. Does NOT modify profile. Fails if farmer not registered.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: agristack_fetch_land_records
description: Fetches land records from state databases (e.g., Bhulekh). Data availability varies by state. Returns land parcel details, ownership info, and area. Requires session_token. Does NOT verify ownership. Fails if state system unavailable or no records found.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: agristack_verify_land_ownership
description: Verifies whether the farmer is the owner of a specific land parcel by cross-referencing Aadhaar with state records. Transitions land_record_status to 'pending_verification' then 'verified' or 'rejected'. Requires session_token. Does NOT fetch records — use agristack_fetch_land_records first. Fails if Aadhaar does not match land owner or parcel not found.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

land_parcel_id.description: Unique identifier for a land parcel as per state records.

name: agristack_check_land_status
description: Checks verification status of a land parcel. Returns land_record_status ('unverified', 'pending_verification', 'verified', 'rejected'). Requires session_token. Does NOT initiate verification. Fails if land_parcel_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

land_parcel_id.description: Unique identifier for a land parcel.

name: agristack_declare_crop
description: Declares a crop for a specific verified land parcel. Crop declaration is per-parcel, not global. Land must be in 'verified' status. Requires session_token. Does NOT provide advisory. Fails if land not verified or crop type unsupported.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: agristack_manage_consent
description: Grants or revokes consent for sharing farmer data with other services. Consent-based sharing is mandatory. Transitions consent_status. Requires session_token. Does NOT share data — only manages permissions. Fails if invalid action.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: agristack_get_registry_status
description: Returns comprehensive registry status including profile_status, number of linked parcels, verification status, and consent status. Requires session_token. Does NOT modify any status. Fails if farmer not registered.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: agristack_register_land_parcel
description: Registers a new land parcel to the farmer's profile. Parcel starts as 'unverified'. Requires session_token. Does NOT verify ownership — use agristack_verify_land_ownership. Fails if parcel already registered or details invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

land_parcel_id.description: Land parcel ID from state records.

name: agristack_update_profile
description: Updates farmer profile details (mobile, address). Requires session_token. Does NOT change Aadhaar or ownership. Verified government records cannot be edited. Fails if farmer not registered.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: agristack_get_linked_land_parcels
description: Returns all land parcels linked to the farmer. Requires session_token. Does NOT register new parcels. Fails if farmer not registered or no parcels linked.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: agristack_raise_grievance
description: Raises AgriStack grievance. Categories: 'land_record_mismatch', 'ownership_issue', 'profile_not_found', 'verification_delay', 'consent_issue'. Must check status first. Requires session_token. Fails if invalid category.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: agristack_track_grievance_status
description: Tracks AgriStack grievance. Requires session_token. Fails if grievance_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.
